name: Kuberik Rollout Dashboard
_comment: EVERY PATH HERE IS RELATIVE TO THIS FILE, AND MUST STAY THAT WAY. The dashboard is served from the ORIGIN ROOT on a cluster and from /demo/ on kuberik.com (see frontend/README.md). An absolute /start_url made the installed app open the marketing site's own home page instead of the dashboard, and absolute /icon-*.png 404'd there. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's own URL, so one file is correct at both roots with no build-time templating.
